items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: The interviewee discusses the Silverleaf Band and Albert Baptiste, but when Radzli is mentioned by the interviewer, the interviewee does not claim a personal relationship, only confirming the interviewer's statement about someone else ('she') being with Radzli.

ctx.x: I think she was. I'm not sure. Was she with the band when you came in? With the Silverleaf Band? No. She wasn't with the band. I think she was with them then. When she was with him? It does. With Albert Baptiste, Silverleaf Band. Yeah. I think she was with them when Hippolyte Charles was playing.
I guess she had gone on with Radzli by then. Probably so. She started with Radzli for years. Yeah.
Yeah. Ah, that's right. Talking about Silverleaf, what was the Silvertone Band then? I don't know. Was that one of your bands?
